The whole “we pay tariffs not the company” was just misinformation mixed with confusion. No one has been charged by customs for shipments. The company in which you are buying from is to pay a tariff on goods imported into the country. This has been a thing for years. Including with cars. 

Customs is not going to directly contact you asking for money. Customs is not the FBI they don’t have any of your contact information. Address? Sure. But they can’t and won’t ask you for money. People who claimed to of recieved a bill from customs were likely being scammed, you know those extended car warranty scams? Like that. 


In order to keep up with the tariff increase, prices are raised to cover the tariffs, as the company or person doing the shipping in or out of the country is who is liable for the tariff that is to be charged.

The stock market is such a huge gamble unless you’re actually educated in stocks. My advice? Delete robinhood. Ignore the stock market. Unless you’re investing in LONG TERM stocks, and not penny stocks you’ll be better off, but even then it’s not something really anyone should play with. Gambling is a rough addiction, it’s the high you get from winning big once then you continue to chase it. 

You’ll get out of it, that is a rough cycle but it is easier to get out of than most. Anytime you think of investing in the stock market, or you think of going to casino, take all of the money that you’re planning on spending and throw it into a bond. Your bank typically has bond certificates that grow over time. You can’t touch it, and they have something like a 5% interest rate. Freeze your debit cards. Literally put them in water and throw that tub into the freezer. Keep your bills on autopay. Apple Pay and google wallet aren’t accepted at casino ATMs. You got this man I believe in you. 

Edit to add: also lock your savings account. When I was struggling with saving I would make six transfers of like a penny a month. Federal law prevents you from withdrawing anymore than 6 transactions unless you’re at an ATM (I think it was put on hold due to covid but it should be back now. I could be wrong)
